name: campuscart-ai
description: Smart Student Stationery Delivery System Using Demand Prediction & Intelligent Inventory Management (MERN + ML)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT,ML" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run server" "npm run client" "npm run ml"
scripts.ml: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path ml-service/venv/Scripts/python.exe) { ml-service/venv/Scripts/python.exe -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir ml-service --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --reload } else { python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir ml-service --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8001 --reload }"
scripts.test:ml: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path ml-service/venv/Scripts/pytest.exe) { ml-service/venv/Scripts/pytest.exe ml-service/tests } else { pytest ml-service/tests }"

author: CampusCart AI Team
